estimate_method.bytes: Exact UTF-8 bytes of the selected source spans and bound schemas; field name retains the requirement vocabulary.
estimate_method.expected_error: Usually about +/-20-40% for mixed Python/JSON/Chinese; minified text, long identifiers, or unusual Unicode can exceed 2x. It is not a tokenizer count.
estimate_method.tokens: Tokenizer-free approximation: CJK code points + ceil(other UTF-8 bytes / 4).

byte_estimate.method: Sum exact current UTF-8 byte lengths for unique selected source spans and bound schemas.
byte_estimate.null_reason: Never null; unreadable source generation fails instead.

capability.method: Collect exact selector values from the entity and its declared capability dependencies.
capability.null_reason: Capability is not applicable to this entity kind.

current_docs.method: Exact-match entity identities, selectors, source paths, and module names; exclude History/Archive prefixes.
current_docs.null_reason: The docs field is scan-derived; an empty array proves no exact current reference.

debt.method: Parse current debt sections and exact-match entity identities or source paths.
debt.null_reason: The debt field is scan-derived; an empty array proves no exact current debt reference.

dependencies.method: Collect declared manifest dependencies or canonical outgoing module edges for exact Python machine sources.
dependencies.null_reason: No governed dependency declaration or graph-bound Python source exists.

domain.method: Use an explicit Skill namespace; otherwise use the first identity component. Debt has no domain binding.
domain.null_reason: The source entity has no machine-owned namespace or domain identity.

issue.method: Extract #N or Issue N only from entity sources and exact-match reference lines; this is textual evidence, not GitHub state.
issue.null_reason: The issue field is scan-derived; an empty array proves no exact textual reference, not that no external Issue exists.

journey.method: Join exact journey_id and covers_journeys values.
journey.null_reason: Journey is not applicable to this entity kind.

maturity.method: Copy the source-owned maturity or lifecycle value without translating vocabularies.
maturity.null_reason: The entity source has no maturity/lifecycle field.

owner.method: Copy only an explicit owner field from the machine source.
owner.null_reason: No machine owner field exists; authorship and Git author are not treated as ownership.

public_surfaces.method: Copy the explicit surface/status object; documentation filenames are not promoted to availability claims.
public_surfaces.null_reason: No explicit public-surface declaration exists for the entity.

schema.method: Join contract schema_version to a schema const, or retain exact component schema source paths.
schema.null_reason: No exact schema_version const or component schema source is bound.

skill.method: Join exact skill_id, covers_journeys, required_skill, and capability selector values.
skill.null_reason: Skill is not applicable to this entity kind.

tests.method: Exact-match entity identities, selectors, source paths, and module names in current tracked tests.
tests.null_reason: The test field is scan-derived; an empty array proves no exact reference in the scanned universe.

token_estimate.method: Count each CJK code point as one token plus ceil(non-CJK UTF-8 bytes / 4).
token_estimate.null_reason: Never null; unreadable source generation fails instead.

generation_metadata.generated_at_reason: volatile timestamps are excluded from the reproducible projection
